title: Entering the clock rewind phase
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $cfg$ be a four-tape configuration over $x$, let $bs$ be a finite Boolean clock word, let $bits$ assign a Boolean to each index below $8$, and let $halt$ be a Boolean flag. If $cfg$ has the pending-action control carrying $bits$ and $halt$, then one step of the timed interpreter from its six-tape lift with clock word $bs$ reaches the clock-rewind phase carrying the same $bits$ and $halt$, with the clock word unchanged and its head at $|bs|-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A four-tape configuration over $x$ whose control is the specified pending-action state
A Boolean action-bit function indexed below 8
replaced:
From the six-tape lift of a four-tape configuration whose control is a
pending-action state, one step of the timed interpreter enters the
clock-rewind phase --- retaining the action's decoded bits and halting flag
--- with the clock head moved to the last clock bit, and without applying any
source transition.
